sketches.mechanism: A let binding is placed in scope before initialization, but the temporal dead zone makes reading it in its own initializer throw a ReferenceError.
sketches.resonance: The self has a name before it can reach itself, and that premature recognition fails.

sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation permits a recursively defined infinite list to exist as long as only finite demand is made of it.
sketches.resonance: Forever is not completed; it survives by giving only the next piece when asked.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references automatically become nil when the referenced object has no remaining strong owner.
sketches.resonance: What is only weakly held vanishes the moment no one keeps it alive.
